chunks: Ahmad, from Ibn Faddal and Ibn Abi Najran, from Ibn Sinan, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
It is appropriate for one who accompanies the جنازة not to sit until it is placed in its lahd; then when it has been placed in its lahd, there is no harm in sitting.

key_terms.شَيَّعَ: accompanied or followed as part of the funeral procession
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.لَحْدِهِ: his grave niche, the side chamber within the grave
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَازَةَ: the funeral bier or deceased being carried for burial

ai.seo_question: When may a person sit after accompanying a funeral procession in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an etiquette and legal guideline for one who accompanies a funeral procession. It instructs that a person should remain standing until the deceased is placed in the grave niche, after which sitting is unobjectionable.
